systems.country_label: civil registry; national identity number (ar-raqm al-watani)
systems.owner: General Directorate for Civil Registration, Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: civil registry offices countrywide and more than a thousand mobile registration units; offices in all major cities of Darfur, none in IDP settlements

note: The civil registry is run by a Ministry of Interior directorate through its own offices; 'local authorities' appear only as the recipient of a paper birth notice, and nothing is stated about a local government office's connection.
